(3) The smoke: P1-tools' second launch is making assets/source/characters/punk/smoke/ (the Gemini flat view, T1-T3 GLBs, bones.json and source.json) in parallel; the lead merges P1-tools into m4/art-pipeline when it is done. If the smoke is there, `git merge origin/m4/art-pipeline` and run the four variants (weights tripo and auto, crossed with punk.glb in the A-pose and punk_rest.glb baked arms-down), make the weights and bind-route A/B stills (Workbench, at the guard, elbow 150, arm raise 140, knee -130 and a spine twist), and look at them. You spend no Tripo credits and make no Gemini images: the fist is Blender-made. Never run more than one Blender process.
